issue: #443 Danny's ruling on the moms «Alimentación» rail (bath toys, descaler, HEPA filters, detergent tablets, a cookbook)
rule: At the moms catalogue's stores (/not-sold.js BABY_STORES) a spare or replacement part, a refill or a machine's component (repuesto), a cleaning consumable (limpieza), a book or guide (publicacion), a plan, subscription or donation (servicio) and what is no baby or mom product at all (ajeno) are off sale; the food those stores listed is off sale everywhere (alimento, farmacia). Each row was cut from the catalogues by scripts/purge-not-sold.mjs; `record` keeps the catalogue row whole (salvage rule). Real products in the wrong type were retyped instead (scripts/apply-moms-truth.mjs).
